spotify.message: track_embeddings.json does not store genre tags for any track (only embedding/name/artist) — genre-overlap evaluation is not obtainable from this artifact, regardless of dataset size.

tourist_spots.caveat: Directional only — sample too small for a reliable confusion matrix (n=4)

dining.caveat: no feedback data exists — precision/recall not measurable.

myntra.ground_truth: none — MyntraFeedback and MyntraEvent both empty

cross_domain.caveat: identical score across all evaluated users — small n, not yet confirmed as a general pattern
